name: Harold P. Keller

roles.title: Corporal, Company E, 2nd Battalion, 28th Marines, 5th Marine Division

summary: An Iowa farmer who had been a Marine Raider before the Raider battalions were broken up into the 5th Marine Division. In October 2019 a second Marine Corps board found that the figure previously identified as Rene Gagnon — the third man from the left, partly hidden — was Keller. He came home, went back to farming near Brooklyn, Iowa, and told his family almost nothing; his daughter learned he was in the photograph from the 2019 announcement, twenty-eight years after his death.
